title: Food + combat composed skills — craftWoodenSword, killOnePig, cookMeat
recordedAt: 2026-07-28T17:18:00Z (take 4 — spectator demo-cam, combat demo on the U4 stage)
scenario: REAL merged U9 skills over live primitives: craftWoodenSword's from-logs chain (8 planks -> sticks -> its own table -> sword), killOnePig over live bot.pvp, cookMeat smelting the porkchop at a fresh furnace with plank fuel.

evidence.onCamera: Spectator shot: pigs wander through the foreground, actor crafts the sword, hunts a pig, walks to the furnace and cooks the porkchop. Final inventory: wooden_swordx1, cooked_porkchopx1.
evidence.liveFindings: Three real bugs across takes: (1) inventory-sync race — countInventory reads stale totals right after a craft (600ms settle in the adapter; assembly note for chained crafts); (2) an unreachable drop wedged the hunt forever — the drill's drop-walk lacked a Promise.race watchdog (the executor's own wedge-regression lesson, reapplied); (3) world wear — the U3 furnace's output slot still held old iron ingots, which leaked into a rehearsal's cook count (fresh furnace for the take).

caveats: craftWoodenSword is a from-logs chain by contract (its docstring says so) — staging gives logs, not planks; plus 2 spare planks as furnace fuel since the chain consumes exactly all 8.
Pigs summoned in the cam cone (the U4 staging pattern).
